problem_detected: Quota-balancing D4 across context classes and then computing Shannon entropy on the same quota-balanced sample would mechanically inflate CRI and create design-induced circularity.

D4_DISCOVERY_BALANCED.purpose: Coverage, rubric calibration, existence proof that the same visual nucleus can support multiple distinct contexts.
D4_DISCOVERY_BALANCED.sampling: Targeted search with minimum coverage goals per preregistered context class.
allowed_outputs: LRS distributions if provenance criteria are met
D4_DISCOVERY_BALANCED.forbidden_output: Do not estimate population CRI from this quota-balanced sample.

D4_PREVALENCE_UNBIASED.purpose: Estimate naturally observed context diversity for CRI.
D4_PREVALENCE_UNBIASED.sampling: Use a fixed reproducible retrieval frame without context quotas, e.g. a chronological/systematic sample of eligible direct Skeleton Dance visual-nucleus captioned items from a defined platform/template result stream. Freeze retrieval rule before coding context.

recommended_retrieval_rule_for_unbiased_.preferred: Platform-bound systematic sampling from one or more fixed source streams where the visual nucleus is pre-filtered independently of caption meaning; then take every eligible item in chronological order or every nth eligible item until target N is reached.
avoid: searching by context words before CRI sampling
dropping repetitive seasonal items merely to improve diversity
using popularity ranking if ranking could correlate with caption semantics unless ranking is itself frozen as part of the sampling frame

interpretation_firewall: Balanced discovery can establish breadth but not prevalence.
Unbiased prevalence sampling can estimate CRI but may miss rare context classes.
High CRI is not proof of virality or causal transmissibility.
Low CRI in the prevalence sample does not negate the existence of rare cross-context reencodings documented in the discovery sample.

stable_interface_score.rule: Compute only with CRI from D4_PREVALENCE_UNBIASED; never substitute entropy from the balanced discovery set.

canonical_seal: TARGETED CONTEXT COVERAGE AND CRI ESTIMATION ARE SEPARATE TASKS. DO NOT MANUFACTURE HIGH ENTROPY BY QUOTA DESIGN.
